integrity: Analytical uniqueness and comparative-statics arguments supported by an exact-rational Fisher reconstruction and numerical root checks in check.py; evidence is not an independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Local Fisher-optimal design at true stationary occupancy 1/2, with this occupancy treated as unknown nuisance, known detection efficiency, two instantaneous visits per independent site, stationary homogeneous two-state Markov transition and no false positives. The optimal limit as detection tends to zero does not mean estimation is possible at zero detection. No constraints on calendar or survey cost, and no independent replication study are supplied.
title: Detectability-dependent optimal revisit interval for a two-state ecological occupancy process
